crossRefs.note: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him, and were amazed.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him, and were amazed.
translations.bsb: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astounded.
translations.kjv: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.
